messages.content: 想像一下你是一個無人機操作員。你目前正在操作一架位於天空中的無人機，座標為（5，7）。你被要求將無人機移動到一個新的座標（10，15）。到達新座標後，你又被要求將無人機移動到另一個座標（20，25）。你能用歐幾里得範數法計算出無人機總共飛行的距離嗎？

function.name: math_hypot
function.description: Calculate the Euclidean norm, sqrt(sum(squares)), the length of the vector from the origin to point (x, y) which is the hypotenuse of the right triangle. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

z.description: Optional. The z-coordinate value. Default is 0.

message.content:
**Step‑by‑step calculation**

| Segment | Displacement \((\Delta x,\;\Delta y)\) | Euclidean norm \(=\sqrt{(\Delta x)^2+(\Delta y)^2}\) |
|---------|----------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| From \(P_0=(5,\,7)\) → \(P_1=(10,\,15)\) | \((5,\;8)\) | \(\displaystyle \sqrt{5^{2}+8^{2}}=\sqrt{25+64}= \sqrt{89}\approx 9.43\) |
| From \(P_1=(10,\,15)\) → \(P_2=(20,\,25)\) | \((10,\;10)\) | \(\displaystyle \sqrt{10^{2}+10^{2}}=\sqrt{100+100}= \sqrt{200}\approx 14.14\) |

---

### Total flight distance  
Add the two segment lengths:

\[
D_{\text{tot}}
   = \sqrt{89}+\sqrt{200}
   \approx 9.43 + 14.14
   \approx 23.57 .
\]

So the drone travels **approximately 23.6 units** (in whatever coordinate unit you’re measuring—meters if your coordinates were meters).

If you prefer an exact symbolic form, keep it as  

\[
\boxed{\sqrt{89}+\sqrt{200}}\quad (\text{exactly } \sqrt{89}+\sqrt{200})
\]
